q6.question: Can a macro-state produce a reproducible intervention effect beyond matched micro, wrapper, and central-control alternatives?
Can a non-saturated held-out task identify a causal effect of a durable canonical revision?
Can causal identification, multiscale credit, useful topology, world-self continuity, and composition be constructed rather than assumed?
Can co-eligible alternatives and outcome-bound feedback identify a local selection effect?
Can one declared mechanism beat strong information- and resource-matched controls on a fresh task?
Can the implemented canonical path be bound to an independently evaluated outcome and changed behavior?
How can bounded coordination artifacts remain useful without being misreported as HSWM cognition or learning?
What exact model, independent outcome custody, source cutoff, cohort, metric, and total resource accounting will make RU-1 testable?
Which C1-C3 concepts become necessary in a preregistered causal mechanism, rather than remaining design vocabulary?
Which historical mechanism families are retired, underdetermined, or still eligible for a distinct successor hypothesis?
Which replaceable realization can meet the target without lowering its intervention, outcome, and provenance requirements?
Which strong native, text, program, retrieval, and fixed-orchestration baselines are appropriate for each claimed mechanism?
Who provides the second-party role needed for G0-external, or is that gate explicitly left unstarted?
Can RU-1 beat native history, text, program, and frozen-policy controls with removal, sham, and restoration?
Can a capability boundary be exercised without becoming a canonical-write or learning bypass?
Can a source-authenticated external graph interface support a future experiment without becoming a canonical-write path?
Can any bounded HSWM mechanism retain an effect after those matched alternatives are tested?
Can one simultaneous runtime witness satisfy all required obligations under external outcome evaluation?
Can outcome, credit, revision, and changed behavior be causally identified without leakage or holdout reuse?
Can remediation proposals be implemented and then compared under matched cost and outcome contracts?
Can the local result be independently replayed and externally adjudicated without changing its frozen protocol?
Can the same contract be demonstrated at two scales while preserving rights, exit, provenance, and lineage?
How should negative-result lineage be surfaced in a standard graph without implying a current live learning path?
What finite evidence sequence is sufficient for a bounded v1 milestone while leaving the broader target unclaimed?
What mapping loss remains when standards-based projections are used as bounded views?
What single run will satisfy D-4's outcome-to-real-canonical-revision-to-changed-heldout-behavior contract?
